task.summary: Default task

Add chat widget feature and related UI components
Integrates a new chat widget feature for user interaction, with toggle and message functionality. Includes styling updates, utility changes, and new assets like the chat icon SVG. Updates .gitignore and adds configuration files for project setup.

Simplify dev script and update .gitignore entries.
Replaced multi-command dev script with a single Next.js dev command for easier maintenance. Updated .gitignore to exclude SSL-related files, zip archives, and IDE configurations.

Simplify dev script and update .gitignore entries.
Replaced the multi-command dev script with a single Next.js dev command to improve maintainability. Adjusted .gitignore to exclude SSL-related files, zip archives, and IDE-specific configurations for cleaner version control.

Update chat widget props and remove unused dependencies
Updated the `accountName` prop in `ChatWidgets` and fixed an import format in `page.tsx`. Additionally, purged obsolete dependencies from `package.json` and cleaned up the `pnpm-lock.yaml` file to align with these changes, ensuring a leaner build setup.

Remove unused code and update data references
Removed the notification feature and redundant states from `TanyaIsma`. Replaced `dummyData` with `packageDetailData` for consistency in data usage on the Umrah Ideal Page. Cleaned up unused imports and polished IDE configuration for improved clarity and maintainability.

Reduce button size and image dimensions in Tanya Isma section
Updated button size and image dimensions to improve visual alignment and responsiveness. This ensures a more consistent UI across different screen sizes.

Add dynamic file serving API route to public folder
This new API route handles GET requests for files in the public directory dynamically based on the slug in the URL. It returns the file content with appropriate headers or a 404 error if the file is not found.

Remove unused file and update dependency configurations
Deleted `route.ts` due to redundancy and cleaned up unnecessary dependencies in the lockfile. This streamlines the codebase, eliminates outdated packages, and reduces potential maintenance overhead.

Add Google Analytics integration with route tracking
Introduced Google Analytics to track pageviews via `gtag.js`. Added a `AnalyticsTracker` component to log route changes using Next.js `usePathname`. Updated global types and layout setup to ensure seamless analytics functionality.

Update Google Analytics config and workspace settings
Removed redundant `page_path` parameter in GA config for streamlined tracking logic. Adjusted IDE workspace settings to switch recent branch from `development` to `feat/google-tag-mnager`.

Add about us page with mission, gallery, and services
Implemented dynamic "About Us" page sections, including mission points, service cards, an image gallery, and a newsletter subscription. Added reusable components, data types, and assets to enhance maintainability and user experience.

Update gallery image paths in about-us section
Revised the file paths for gallery images to align with the updated directory structure. This ensures consistency and correct image rendering in the about-us section.

Remove unused components and refactor UI elements
Deleted obsolete components (`map-embedded` and `scroll-observer`) to simplify the codebase. Refactored sections for improved layout, accessibility, and responsiveness. Introduced a new API route (`getPlaceDetails`) for fetching Google Maps place details and updated dependencies to support the changes.

Remove unused components and enhance interactive map
Deleted obsolete components (`map-embedded` and `scroll-observer`) to streamline the codebase. Refactored the interactive map to include a global `initMap` function and updated the Google Maps API script for callback handling. Replaced map marker implementation with `AdvancedMarkerElement` for improved functionality and refined UI styling for better consistency.

Refactor "Tanya Isma" and interactive map functionality
Replaced animations in "Tanya Isma" for simplicity and updated the chat prompt text to improve user engagement. Enhanced interactive map with global `initMap`, added map ID configuration, and replaced marker with `AdvancedMarkerElement`. Minor UI adjustments and removal of unused components to streamline the codebase.

Refactor "Tanya Isma" and enhance interactive map
Simplified "Tanya Isma" by removing animations and updating chat prompts for better engagement. Improved the interactive map by adding a global `initMap`, introducing map ID configuration, and refining marker implementation with `AdvancedMarkerElement`. Updated UI placeholders for consistency and streamlined the codebase by removing unused components.

Refactor interactive map to improve place name display.
Split place names into first part and remaining text for better formatting. Adjusted layout styles for padding and margins to enhance visual structure.

Refactor analytics, maps, and global type handling.
Replaced legacy analytics setup with modularized GA, GTM, and FB Pixel components. Switched from an interactive map to Google Maps integration with API-driven dynamic place details. Introduced nonce-based CSP via middleware and improved global type declarations for enhanced security and structure.

Add marker icon to public assets
This commit introduces a new marker.png icon to the public assets folder. It will be used to visually represent locations or points of interest in the application.

Replace PriorityImage with Next.js Image and add priorities.
Updated all instances of PriorityImage to use Next.js' Image component for consistency and better performance. Added "priority" or "loading" attributes where necessary to optimize image loading. Introduced a new API route for Facebook conversion tracking and refined middleware and CSP handling to enhance security.

Update marker icon in assets
Replaced the existing marker icon in the assets folder with a new version. This change ensures an updated visual representation for the marker icon in the application.

Refactor conversion API to use NextResponse and NextRequest
Updated the conversion API route to utilize Next.js' NextResponse and NextRequest for improved handling of responses and request headers. Replaced direct header access with `headers.get` and streamlined client IP extraction. These changes enhance code clarity and compatibility with Next.js app directory conventions.

Refactor navbar icon styles and improve code clarity
Updated navbar icons to dynamically change styles based on route activation for better UI feedback. Simplified and standardized class naming conventions across components for improved readability and maintainability. Adjusted the about-us page background styles for enhanced visual alignment.

Refactor Google Maps setup and improve middleware CSP
Replaced manual script loading with `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` for improved API handling and error management in Google Maps integration. Enhanced middleware Content Security Policy (CSP) by including additional Google APIs and refined matcher configuration. These changes improve overall clarity, maintainability, and reliability of map rendering and security policies.

Add null check to prevent potential crashes
Ensure that the code gracefully handles null input values to avoid runtime errors. This change improves stability and prevents unexpected application behavior.

Fix issues in ChatBox component rendering and improve imports
Replaced `next/legacy/image` with `next/image` for better performance and future compatibility. Removed unnecessary parentheses in JSX, improving code readability and structure. Added spacing adjustments for more consistent formatting and cleaner layout.

Refactor Google Maps integration and improve email subscription.
Replaced custom Google Maps script loading with `@googlemaps/js-api-loader` for better error handling and API integration. Added Mailchimp-based newsletter subscription API with email validation and improved submission feedback. Updated UI components to use `next/image` for optimized image handling.

Enhance `GalleryImage` component with dynamic dimensions.
Added optional `width` and `height` props to the `GalleryImage` component for greater flexibility. Updated the gallery images to use these new properties for improved rendering customization.

Remove debug logs and minor refactors in multiple files
Eliminated unnecessary `console.error` and `console.log` statements across several components to clean up the codebase. Included minor style updates and refactors for improved readability and performance. These changes enhance maintainability and reduce noise in the application.
